note: Freeze-before-peek: this lock is committed before any metric, signal, or simulation is computed on the real data. SCREEN_FAIL is a valid outcome; do not widen the grid, cut costs, move the holdout, or relax the null gate to manufacture a passer.

data.source: Vantage Standard STP live terminal export (ExportInstrumentHistory, run_id e2604bb028884569ad65ade0c1d3d3f5)

clock.rule: server wall clock = America/New_York + 7h (tracks US DST)
clock.never_use: us_index_session_backtest.load_m5_csv offset path (constant server_utc_offset_sec mislabels every US-winter bar by 1h in ET)
clock.verification: rollover spread spike modal minute = 17:00 ET and 08:30 ET data-release volume spike modal minute, both in JAN(EST) and JUL(EDT) 2021-2026, on this export

session.entry_window: [08:00, 17:00) ET (FX NY convention, DST-safe local clock)
session.force_flat: 16:45 ET same-day, at first bar open >= 16:45 (before the 17:00 rollover spread blowout)
session.friday_cutoff: no new entries at or after 14:00 ET Friday

book.equity_floor: equity > 0 asserted at every fill; simulation aborts on breach
book.risk_reasoning: 100 = 1% of book = the daily goal, so the goal reads as median trade-day >= +1R against a -3R halt, leaving room for three full losses in a day. At 300 the per-trade risk would equal the halt, making every config one-loss-and-done. R:R is size-invariant (it is just TP/SL), so this choice does not change which configs rank - it changes how many trades a day survives and how the goal reads.
book.lots_formula: floor_to_step(risk_per_trade_usd / (sl_points * point_value_per_lot), 0.01), computed at entry from that trade's own SL distance, then clamp to [min_lot, lot_cap]
book.lot_cap_note: defensive only: at risk 100 / min_sl_points 80 the max size is 1.25 lots, so lot_cap cannot bind through a live trade
book.min_sl_points_rule: skip the trade if the stop is nearer than 80 points - do not resize into it
invariants: sl_points * lots * point_value_per_lot <= risk_per_trade_usd at EVERY fill (tight invariant)
worst single-trade risk <= daily_halt_usd (looser check, implied by the tight invariant)

rejected_seed.setup: 6 lots per 10000 USD, TP 0.2%, SL 1% (user's initial recommended numbers)
rejected_seed.why_rejected: at 6.0 lots round-trip friction at median spread = $132 = 1.32x the $100 daily goal; SL 0.25% = $1,620 and SL 1.0% = $6,480 = 5.4x-22x the -$300 halt, so every SL in the grid blows the halt on its first loser
rejected_seed.honored_as: one replay-only sensitivity at the frozen best config, clearly labeled, never ranked, never searched

costs.commission_note: Vantage Standard STP: spread-inclusive, no separate commission (account type STANDARD_STP)
costs.slippage_note: STATED ASSUMPTION, not measured - MT5 exposes slippage only on executed deals
costs.max_spread_note: ~p99 of measured spread; a tail guard rejecting ~1% of bars, not a filter
costs.spread_imputation: 3 zero-spread bars (8.2e-6 of 368,302): forward-fill previous bar spread within the same ET day, else global median 12
costs.cost_formula: round trip = (spread_pts + 2 * slippage_points) * point_size * contract_size * lots + 2 * commission_per_lot * lots, charged once at fill

fills_and_exits.signal_to_fill: signal on close of bar i, fill at open of bar i+1 (same ET day only)
fills_and_exits.intrabar_precedence: SL-first (pessimistic) when a bar touches both
fills_and_exits.short_fill_convention: bid-space: MT5 OHLC is bid; a short covers at ask, so short TP tests low <= TP - spread and short SL tests high >= SL - spread, filling at the shifted level; longs unadjusted; the single round-trip spread deduction is retained (not a double count)

risk.daily_halt_rule: -3% realized-day: once cumulative day PnL <= -300, no NEW entries that ET day (open position still managed to its exit/flatten)
risk.session_lock_note: +1%/day is a REPORTED metric only, never an exit rule (an exit rule keyed on realized day PnL doubles the search space for no hypothesis)

goals.normalization: equity path: day_pct = day_pnl / equity_at_day_start (NOT a static balance); month = sum of day_pnl / equity_at_month_start
goals.trade_days_only: medians over ET days/months that actually traded

holdout.holdout_boundary_unit: ET session-date (et_date < 2025-03-01 = develop; >= = holdout). Note: the instrument-data lane's holdout_start_server '2026-01-01 00:00:00' is server-clock = 2025-12-31 17:00 ET; different lane, different unit, do not mix.
holdout.split_basis: chosen from the measured span after export (1,541 ET days): develop 1,080 days (70.1%), holdout 461 days (29.9%) - the ~70/30 target
holdout.holdout_rule: NEVER used for selection. Selection ranks develop-only. Holdout is scored only after the ranking is frozen.
holdout.peek_status: Holdout 2025-03-01 → 2026-08-20 overlaps the instrument-data lane's EURUSD H1 develop window (server_time < 2026-01-01) and EURUSD appears in several XAU exogenous charters. Not verified whether those selections actually touched this window — record-and-check, not a contamination finding. Contamination would bias toward false positives; this run found zero, and the holdout was never used for selection. Stated here per CLAUDE.md 'do not relabel already-peeked windows as OOS' and the v8 burned-buffer precedent.
holdout.assert_not_default: effective holdout_start must NOT equal us_index_session_backtest.HOLDOUT_START (2026-06-01)

grid.ranking: develop-only: eligible = trades >= 40 and net_pnl > 0; rank by profit_factor (None/inf pinned to 3.0) then expectancy

frozen_params.vwap: session VWAP from first bar >= 08:00 ET, typical price x tick_volume, volume floor 1
frozen_params.pullback: long: bar i-1 low <= EMA9 or VWAP (pullback touch), bar i closes back above EMA9 with EMA9 > EMA21 and close > VWAP; short mirror
frozen_params.volume_confirm: bar i tick_volume > 1.2 x rolling 20-bar mean (excluding bar i)

frozen_params.entry: long: close < lower band AND RSI7 < 30; short: close > upper band AND RSI7 > 70

breakout.description: consolidation box break + volume spike + EMA ribbon fan (user strategy 3)

frozen_params.box: high/low of bars [i-12, i-1] inclusive (strictly prior to signal bar)
frozen_params.entry: long: close > box high AND tick_volume >= 2 x rolling 20-bar mean AND ribbon fanned (EMA8 > EMA10 > EMA12 > EMA15); short mirror

exits_32: structure TP (family-native target: trend = prior-20-bar extreme (recent high/low, per user strategy 1); mean_reversion = BB middle band; breakout = box-height projection from the box extreme) x SL {0.25,0.50,1.00}%  (3)
time-stop: flat at open of bar fill+6 / fill+12, SL 1.00% guard  (2)

null_calibration.procedure: within-ET-day circular phase rotation of M5 close-to-close log returns: per ET day, one uniform rotation offset drawn from the seeded RNG, returns rolled circularly, OHLC rebuilt (open = day's first open, then cumprod); volumes, spreads, times unchanged; full 192-config grid re-run per seed; rank develop-only exactly as the real run
null_calibration.max_null_best: max over the 10 seeds of the top-ranked develop config's median_trade_day_pct
null_calibration.gate: the real run's top-ranked develop config must have median_trade_day_pct >= max_null_best + 0.5 * goal_daily (0.5pp margin). Without the margin the develop winner is indistinguishable from best-of-192 selection noise.
null_calibration.order: null run BEFORE the real run; both after this freeze
null_calibration.caveat: max-of-10-seeds is itself an estimate; the null preserves intraday autocorrelation within days (phase rotation is circular, not iid shuffling), so it is conservative for signal-frequency but not a full block bootstrap
